body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces the Phase B full beta source map builder script, validator results, readback documentation, and associated unit tests. The feedback highlights two key areas for improvement: correcting double backslashes in regex literals within the test assertions to ensure credential leak detection functions properly, and adding fail-closed test cases to verify validator behavior when input files are missing or malformed.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
